meta.title: Surrogate bid placed in a Reverse Auction stage
gaps: The 'Surrogate Bid' label is blue and positioned next to the currency under the vendor name in the auction QCS.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The 'Surrogate Bid' label is blue and positioned next to the currency under the vendor name in the auction QCS.

steps.note: Open a suitable existing live event for the bid flow.
Navigate to the live Reverse Auction stage.
Open the stage's Participants section to reach the vendor's Add Bid control.
Enter and submit a buyer-entered bid for the participating vendor.
Verify that the surrogate bid submission was accepted.
Open the auction QCS to inspect the recorded vendor bid.
Verify that the QCS displays the surrogate-bid attribution.
